user.title: Danfoss Ally Gateway (local)
user.description: Connect to the gateway over your local network using the Tuya LAN protocol. See the README for how to find the device ID and the local key of your own gateway.

data_description.host: IP address of the Danfoss Ally Gateway. Give it a fixed address in your router.
data_description.device_id: The gateway's Tuya device ID (22 characters).
data_description.local_key: The gateway's Tuya local key (16 characters). It changes if the gateway is reset or paired again.
data_description.protocol_version: Tuya LAN protocol version. Ally gateways use 3.5.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the gateway's local key
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway rejected the local key. This happens if the gateway was reset or re-paired.

data_description.local_key: The gateway's Tuya local key (16 characters). It changes if the gateway is reset or paired again.
data_description.protocol_version: Tuya LAN protocol version. Ally gateways use 3.5.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the gateway. Check the IP address, and that nothing else (LocalTuya, tinytuya) holds the single local connection.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway rejected the local key or protocol version.
error.no_subdevices: Connected, but the gateway reported no sub-devices.

init.title: Device names
init.description: The gateway's local protocol carries no names, so name each device here. Fields are labelled with the device's Zigbee node id; clear a field to go back to the default name.
